_note: The ONE switch: panoSource = "blender" (JOB/work/pano360/<room>.png) or "real" (JOB/work/pano360/real/<room>.jpg). Then run prep.mjs and build-tour (REBUILD.md in JOB/qa/360/). prep.mjs --source <name> overrides this line for one run.

blender.note: Blender Cycles equirectangular renders of the Hatzav scene, 2048×1024, 48 samples (JOB/work/pano360/<room>.png + .png.json)

real.note: the realism pass over the Blender renders, 4096×2048 JPEG with the 360 seam closed (written by the main session; an AI image pass). The .png beside each is the raw model answer with an open seam and is NEVER used

living.why: coordinator 2026-11-18: the walk view (560,930) stood 0.6–0.9 m from the TV unit; the 360 living camera is at u=700, v=880, eye 155

dining.why: coordinator 2026-11-18: the walk view (300,630) stood 45 cm from the table; the 360 dining camera is at u=420, v=620, eye 155

conceptLine.he: הדמיה ממודל תלת־ממדי לפי תכנית המכר. הריהוט והחומרים להמחשה בלבד; חלק מהפריטים נוצרו בעזרת AI לפי הדמיות היזם.
conceptLine.en: A visualization from a 3D model built to the sales plan. Furniture and materials are for illustration only; some items were made with AI from the developer's renderings.
conceptLine.fr: Visualisation d'après un modèle 3D construit selon le plan de vente. Mobilier et matériaux à titre indicatif ; certains objets ont été créés par IA d'après les rendus du promoteur.

aiNote.fr: Rendu d'un modèle 3D · mobilier en partie créé par IA · pas des photographies du bien
